# Hamza Hassan Elgzairy (حمزة حسن الجزايري)

> Hamza Hassan Elgzairy is an Egyptian technology entrepreneur and the CEO of Megsy LLC, an artificial intelligence software company based in Egypt. Megsy LLC builds Megsy AI, a single workspace for AI conversation, writing, image creation, code and documents.

Official photo: /hamza-hassan-elgzairy.jpg
